mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in the document's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the client's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, officers and key counterparties must be screened against the VFIU national sanctions list, UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated list and FATF public statements. Screening is refreshed within 24 hours and recorded in the AML/CFT compliance file pursuant to the AML Act No. 21 of 2017 (ss. 15-17).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Office registry and licensed registered agents' electronic filing channel
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Latin characters using English or French spelling; Bislama names are accepted if submitted in Latin script. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing name or a name reserved in the VFSC register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30-day period on payment of the prescribed renewal fee. Upon rejection, the applicant (through the licensed registered agent) must file a written appeal with the VFSC Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, specifying the grounds and paying the prescribed appeal fee. The Registrar must issue a determination within 10 business days. If the administrative appeal is dismissed, the applicant may further appeal to the Courts of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only in the sense that a licensed registered agent maintains a physical office in Vanuatu as the statutory registered office. A pure virtual mailbox, without a physical address, does not satisfy the International Companies Act. The company must maintain adequate records and a registered agent as a commercial substance measure.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (~5% annual probability) for a standard international company in the low-risk EOR platform sector; inspections increase significantly if regulatory filings are missed or suspicious transactions are flagged.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], sections 4-17 (incorporation), 20-27 (memorandum and articles), 35-40 (directors and secretary), and 54 (tax exemption); Companies (International Companies) Regulation, 1993.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Incorporation of an International Company, with annexed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed by the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; no statutory escrow or deposit account is required. Authorised share capital is fixed in the Memorandum and shares may be issued partly paid.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the initial subscriber as sole incorporating director, that: (1) the Company's issued shares be allotted to the subscriber; (2) the registered office be established at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila and the registered agent be appointed; (3) [Name] acts as Director and [Name] as Company Secretary without remuneration, holding office until the next annual general meeting; and (4) the Memorandum and Articles of Association are adopted and any lawful act necessary to commence the global EOR payroll business may be effected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry (submitted via the licensed Vanuatu registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two preferred company names, each ending in 'Limited' or 'Ltd', to the licensed registered agent. The agent screens the proposed names against the VFSC register, reserved-name list, and prohibited-word schedule, and confirms availability in writing before any constitutional document is engrossed.
required_dossiers: Statement of proposed activities (global EOR, contractor payroll administration)
Passport copy of each ultimate beneficial owner and director candidate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the first-choice name is rejected for similarity or prohibited words, the agent files the alternate name within 1 business day; no additional government fee is levied.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution and Notarization of Constitutional Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent and Notary Public (Port Vila)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association using the model form prescribed by the 1993 Regulation, inserts the capital clause and objects clause for cross-border HR and payroll intermediation, and arranges for subscriber signature. All subscriber signatures are notarised and the registered agent executes its formal consent to act.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (original engrossment)
Consent to Act as Registered Agent
Subscriber due-diligence pack (corporate register extract or passport)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the objects clause, the agent submits a memorandum addendum expressly excluding licensed activities (banking, insurance, trust, reinsurance) as required by Part III of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Application and Payment of State Incorporation Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry (counters or approved electronic payment channel)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files Form 1 with the engrossed Memorandum and Articles of Association, together with the Consent to Act as Registered Agent, and pays the USD 300 (VUV equivalent) government incorporation fee at the VFSC-daily rate. VFSC issues a payment receipt and commences a statutory 5-business-day vetting review.
required_dossiers: Two original engrossments of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: VFSC file queries must be answered by the registered agent within 7 days; failure to respond leads to deemed abandonment and refund, cured by refiling with corrected schedules.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon completion of vetting, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation, assigns a unique company number, and enters the Company into the International Companies Register. The registered agent retrieves the certificate and engrossed statutory filing from VFSC and delivers a certified copy to the director.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate is lost, the Company applies to the Registrar for a certified duplicate upon submission of an indemnity and payment of the VFSC duplicate-certificate fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inaugural Governance - First Board Resolution and Statutory Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Secretary / Initial Board of Directors (acting at the VFSC-registered office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The director executes the first board resolution, subscribes and issues share certificate(s), and the secretary opens the statutory registers of members, directors, charges, and beneficial ownership. The board further resolves to adopt the EOR client-master agreement template and the segregated payroll operating protocol.
required_dossiers: Statutory register templates (members, directors, charges, beneficial owners)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Default in completing statutory registers is cured under the Company's officer-default powers; no penalty attaches if the registers are completed within 28 days of incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Compliance Calendar and Banking Arrangements
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC / Licensed Registered Agent / Vanuatu banking institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The agent establishes the annual VFSC renewal calendar, registers the company for the mandatory annual fee, and opens the operating bank account. Legal counsel confirms in writing that the Company will not carry on business with residents of Vanuatu, thereby preserving the exemption from all Vanuatu taxes under section 54 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
required_dossiers: Proof of registered office address (VFSC consent letter)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or counterparty challenges tax status, the Company obtains from VFSC a Certificate of Good Standing and a legal opinion citing section 54 of the International Companies Act, within 5 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Licensing and Enforcement Division, in coordination with the Vanuatu Department of Labour
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Licence-Exempt Registration with VFSC Statement of No Objection for Cross-Border Global EOR and Contractor Payroll Operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Administrative Registration Only (Schedule 3 non-listed service activity; no full EIA Study or EIA Report required for office-based EOR payroll operations)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial point-source discharge. Workplace waste must comply with the Environmental Protection Act [Cap. 283] and municipal solid-waste bylaws; office air emissions (printing and HVAC) remain below DEPC de-minimis thresholds; volatile organic compounds generated solely from office consumables are managed under workplace ventilation standards consistent with Vanuatu's general environmental duty.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued under the Vanuatu Fire Service Act [Cap. 143] for the registered office and any servicing premises; structural load and occupancy load inspection certification under the Vanuatu National Building Code; occupational health and safety induction and workplace clearance under the Vanuatu Occupational Health and Safety legislation; civil-defense evacuation plan filed with the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu; official portal: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue e-services (https://www.customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu as provided by the Government of Vanuatu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For an International Company (IC) formed under the Vanuatu International Companies Act, the IC must be registered with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through a licensed registered agent. The VFSC-issued Certificate of Incorporation is the foundational corporate/tax identifier. If the IC carries on any Vanuatu domestic taxable activity or exceeds the VAT registration threshold, it must apply to the Commissioner of Customs and Inland Revenue for a VAT Registration Number / Tax Identification Number, submitting the VFSC certificate, registered agent confirmation, beneficial ownership declaration, local contact details, and evidence of taxable activity. For wholly offshore operations, the IC relies on its VFSC tax-exempt status and annual renewal; no separate CIT or income tax registration is required because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: The Vanuatu International Company is a non-resident, tax-exempt legal form. It is exempt from Vanuatu corporate income tax, stamp duty, VAT on offshore transactions, exchange control, and capital-based levies. Tax liability exposure is limited to any accidental domestic taxable activity, customs/VAT on physical imports into Vanuatu for domestic use, and annual VFSC fees.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no US-style check-the-box election. An International Company may elect to continue/convert into a domestic company under the Vanuatu Companies Act, thereby losing IC tax-exempt status. An IC may voluntarily register for VAT even below the statutory threshold. Hybrid mismatch elections are unavailable because Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax or a general deduction regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 245
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 3,000,000 of taxable turnover in a consecutive 12-month period; International Companies undertaking wholly offshore business are outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory real-time e-invoicing, digital stamping, or continuous fiscal clearance regime is currently in force in Vanuatu. VAT-registered persons must issue prescribed VAT tax invoices for taxable supplies and keep source records, customs export declarations, transport documents, and payment evidence for statutory review. VAT returns are filed through the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue's approved e-filing/paper filing procedures, with export zero-rating substantiation retained for inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from Vanuatu qualify for 0% VAT upon physical export, evidenced by an electronic customs export declaration and removal from Vanuatu. Offshore services supplied by the IC to non-resident EOR clients, such as global staffing/contractor payroll services, are treated as outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT when the services are not performed or consumed in Vanuatu and the beneficiary is a non-resident. The IC must substantiate the non-resident status of the foreign client, the offshore service contract, and the absence of domestic use. Input VAT refunds on local costs are available only to the extent the IC is VAT-registered and uses those costs to make taxable or zero-rated supplies; wholly offshore ICs normally have no Vanuatu input VAT recovery because no corresponding domestic taxable activity exists.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs-approved Export Declaration / Export Entry with clearance status
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing shipment out of Vanuatu
Packing List and proof of export/removal
Foreign client contract or service agreement for offshore EOR/contractor payroll services
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank statement showing payment in foreign currency from the non-resident client
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Commissioner of Customs and Inland Revenue may retrospectively assess VAT on any supply claimed as zero-rated or outside scope if documentation is incomplete or the destination/beneficiary is not substantiated. Reassessments can claw back previously refunded input VAT, with statutory penalties for underpayment, late payment interest, and additional assessments up to the tax evaded. Fraudulent zero-rating or false export declarations are criminal offenses and may result in fines, imprisonment, loss of the IC's VFSC license, and revocation of tax-exempt status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), also administering the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 61]
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is a floating convertible currency for current account purposes, including payroll remittances and operational trade payments. Capital account transactions, including inbound shareholder capital injections into an International Company, are freely permitted for non-residents, but large outbound capital transfers and cross-border loans may require prior RBV approval through an authorized dealer bank. Vanuatu International Companies are treated as non-resident for exchange control purposes and may hold foreign currency accounts, enabling unrestricted dividend and profit remittances provided the company is not conducting prohibited domestic business with Vanuatu residents. There are no material hurdles to current account convertibility or outward profit remittance for a properly licensed Global EOR/Staffing entity transacting exclusively with overseas clients and contractors.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds. There is no export proceeds surrender regime under the Exchange Control Act or RBV directives. Exporters and International Companies may retain foreign currency receipts in designated foreign currency accounts with authorized dealers without any obligation to convert into VUV within a specified period. This facilitates flow-through payroll funding and offshore invoicing for an International Company engaged in global EOR services.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Payroll Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Payroll Account
Operational Account only; Capital Escrow viability partially restricted
Operational Account and limited Foreign Currency Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) are not licensed or regulated by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu and cannot independently provide clearing or settlement in VUV without a local authorized dealer. Wise and similar global EMIs are viable only through a commercial arrangement with a Vanuatu-regulated bank or as a supplementary disbursement channel for payroll to employees in low-risk jurisdictions. The core treasury architecture should maintain a primary VUV and USD account with a Tier 1 onshore bank, with offshore EMIs used exclusively for sub-15,000 USD contractor payments where expedited cross-border delivery is commercially justified. Legal constraint: an EMI that is not an authorized dealer cannot perform exchange control functions, issue documentary credits, or hold client money as a bank in Vanuatu.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical appearance is generally required for at least one director or an appointed authorized signatory at the main branch during initial account opening for an International Company. Major Vanuatu banks permit remote opening for non-resident directors only if: (i) all corporate constitutive documents and director passports are notarized and apostilled; (ii) the beneficial owner completes a video interview with the bank's compliance officer; and (iii) the Vanuatu registered agent passes an attestation that the entity is in good standing. A purely online no-touch opening is not possible for a VU International Company; a physical or video interview mandate is embedded in each bank's AML/CFT program.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shell-company red flag stemming from zero-tax offshore International Company structure and absence of economic substance in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation from Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); current registered agent certificate; audited or management accounts demonstrating real EOR business activities; employer and payroll contracts (master service agreements, employment contracts, vendor agreements with staffing clients); a substance memo showing board meetings, documented management functions, and the rationale for using the VU IC; and a tax residence certificate or tax advice confirming passive or exempt status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverified source of funds and source of wealth for shareholder capital injections into the capital escrow account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank references from the remitting bank in the shareholder's jurisdiction covering at least six months; board resolution approving capital contribution; certified shareholder identification and proof of wealth; historical invoices and payroll liabilities demonstrating matching commercial load; and an undertaking to provide the ultimate beneficial ownership declarations under the Companies Act and AML/CFT legislation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee directorship or non-transparent ultimate beneficial owner chains typically associated with Vanuatu offshore vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed Beneficial Ownership Register declaration; organizational chart from shareholder to named individuals with passport and residential address proof; statutory declaration confirming no nominee arrangements existing for the global EOR treasury accounts; and legal opinion from a licensed Vanuatu lawyer or registered agent on the IC's good standing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media flags triggered by client and contracting countries within the EOR payroll network
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions and PEP screening output from a recognized commercial compliance database performed within 10 business days of account opening; explanatory narrative for any government positions held by directors or shareholders; independent legal opinion confirming the staffing transactions do not involve sanctioned counterparties; and ongoing transaction monitoring consent combined with monthly payroll beneficiary declarations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injection must be initiated from the corporate shareholder bank account using SWIFT MT103 with a purpose code corresponding to direct investment capital contribution under IMF BPM6 (Category 521 for equity capital). The payment must be routed to the International Company's VUV corporate bank account or dedicated foreign currency account with an authorized dealer in Vanuatu. Supporting documents required for RBV auditing and bank compliance: board resolution approving the capital injection, constitutional documents, shareholder register, and the bank's capital escrow account opening checklist. The bank will verify that the source bank is in good standing, the remitter is the sole or listed shareholder of the VU IC, and that no funds are being routed through prohibited channels. For all equity injections exceeding USD 50,000 per transfer, the receiving bank should be advised in advance with a compliance letter to prevent administrative embargos.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement for trade flows will be executed primarily via SWIFT MT103 corporate payments from the Vanuatu International Company's operational account to overseas contractor payroll accounts, using standard trade narrative referencing the underlying EOR client and employment contract identifier. Payments for EOR sub-contracted services to major staffing vendors may be supported by Commercial Letters of Credit (documentary credits) opened through ANZ or BSP Vanuatu, with a tenor of 30-60 days and URDG 758 fallback for demand guarantees where necessary. For mass payroll runs to employees in multiple countries, the platform should aggregate payments into a single MT103 file to the destination bank's treasury, then use NACHA or local payment rails downstream, consistent with regional payroll clearing requirements. FX conversion for outbound disbursements will be booked as spot transactions through the Vanuatu authorized dealer where possible; for currencies with shallow local liquidity, the bank will be instructed to execute offshore USD-denominated MT103 transfers with in-country conversion only at final domestic receiving level.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot FX contracts through Vanuatu authorized dealers for immediate VUV/USD/EUR conversion
Ordinary currency forwards with onshore commercial banks covering current account payroll exposures up to 12 months
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV bilateral rates for hedging non-vanuatu payroll cost bases where onshore forward liquidity is insufficient

Vanuatu/USD cross-currency swaps executed through registered international banks under an RBV-delegated authority, provided the swap is linked to actual staffing service receivables and not speculative
Documentary trade finance hedges embedded in Commercial Letters of Credit for large sub-contracted EOR vendor settlements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return under the International Companies Act (Vanuatu)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Section
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of approximately VT 5,000 (US$42); continued default for three months may trigger administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent under Vanuatu AML/CFT obligations (not filed publicly)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation, or within 30 days of a shareholding transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No specific statutory fee; failure may lead to agent resignation, loss of registered office, and administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit for a Vanuatu International Company (IC) irrespective of turnover; audit is required only if the company's articles so provide or if the company holds a regulated financial or securities licence.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) as the acceptable benchmark for internal financial records; no Vanuatu local GAAP applies to International Companies. Books must explain transactions and financial position.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public UBO register exists in Vanuatu. The licensed registered agent must conduct an annual KYC/UBO refresh and keep updated beneficial ownership records. Shareholding transfers require the agent to be notified within 30 days, and the next annual confirmation must reflect the new ownership structure.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable (audit-exempt); if voluntarily audited, approximately US$2,000 – US$5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (nil) — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on International Companies, whether locally or offshore sourced.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero percent CIT floor; ICs engaged exclusively in offshore business are tax-exempt. Indirect fiscal costs: 12.5% VAT on local taxable supplies (zero-rated for exported EOR/payroll services) and municipal business licence fees (Port Vila and Luganville) based on local turnover bands. No payroll taxes, social security contributions, capital gains tax, or stamp duty apply.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return — Value Added Tax Act (No. 4 of 2009); electronically filed through the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (RAV) online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly (calendar quarters ending 31 March, 30 June, 30 September, 31 December); monthly filing may be directed by the Commissioner for larger taxpayers.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the end of each taxable quarter, or such shorter period as the Commissioner of Customs and Revenue directs by notice.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered VAT identification number and IC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC with no local taxable activity is not required to register or file; registration is compulsory only where annual taxable turnover exceeds VT 5,000,000.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 12.5% VAT collected on taxable supplies made during the quarter.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees charged to non-resident clients for exported EOR, contractor payroll administration, and staffing coordination are zero-rated; no output VAT is declared on such invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT paid on imports and local purchases attributable to taxable supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where the IC makes solely zero-rated outward supplies, the full input tax credit is refundable; refund claims must be supported by valid tax invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Excess of output tax over input tax, with payment instruction or refund request.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Net refund claims are processed by RAV; no withholding or remittance obligation to non-resident shareholders arises on such payments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of the taxpayer or authorized representative certifying the accuracy of the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors or the licensed VFSC registered agent may sign; knowingly false certification attracts criminal liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgment penalty of VT 50,000 plus default interest under the VAT Act; deliberate evasion carries fines up to VT 10,000,000 and imprisonment for up to 2 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return of an International Company (Form IC-AR) — International Companies Act (Cap. 222); submitted by the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (filed in respect of each anniversary of incorporation).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after each anniversary of incorporation; the annual government fee is payable on the anniversary date itself.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, IC registration number, and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC may be wholly owned and directed by non-residents; no local shareholding or residency condition applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Vanuatu and the licensed registered agent's details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be maintained in Vanuatu; the agent must be a VFSC-licensed trust or company service provider.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, including classes of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement exists; share issuance may be effected without duty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, and shareholdings of directors and shareholders (kept confidential).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All fields may reflect non-resident individuals or entities; the register is not publicly searchable outside regulatory channels.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: A narrative description of the IC's actual commercial operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an EOR platform, state: cross-border employer-of-record services, global contractor payroll, and ISIC 7810 activities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of whether the IC carries on a relevant activity in Vanuatu and, if so, substance details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Third-party EOR services to unrelated non-resident clients are not a listed ESR relevant activity; if services are rendered to connected group undertakings, the 'service centre' category applies with substance requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of where accounting records are physically kept.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Records may be kept at the registered office or other place in Vanuatu; no corporate income tax computation is required under the zero-CIT regime.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty up to VT 500,000 with a continuing daily surcharge of VT 10,000; persistent default triggers administrative strike-off, restoration fees, and regulatory action against the registered agent.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions by an International Company to resident or non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not engaged: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax treaty network and no domestic dividend withholding tax; consequently no TRC application or treaty-relief clearance is required before paying dividends. Distributions are authorized by board resolution and settled freely through the IC's bank account without exchange control approval. If a shareholder's home jurisdiction requires proof of good standing, the VFSC issues a certificate of incorporation and good standing, but does not certify beneficial-owner tax residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory nil WHT on outbound and inbound royalties and interest; no treaty rate is applicable. An IC may pay or receive cross-border management, IP licensing, intercompany loan interest, and payroll service fees with no statutory deduction at source.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu's zero-CIT regime prescribes no Local File or Master File thresholds and has no transfer-pricing legislation. For ESR purposes, any relevant activity conducted in Vanuatu must be supported by records evidencing adequate premises, employees, and VUV-denominated expenditure proportionate to the activity.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (persuasive OECD-aligned, not codified in Vanuatu statute)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) (Amendment) Act 2019 applies to Vanuatu International Companies carrying on relevant activities: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, pure holding, intellectual property holding, and distribution or service centres. A third-party EOR agency providing global staffing and contractor payroll to unrelated clients is not a listed relevant activity; however, payroll/EOR services rendered to connected group undertakings fall within the service-centre category and require physical presence, qualified employees, premises, and expenditure in Vanuatu commensurate with the activity. Pure holding companies enjoy reduced substance requirements. Non-compliance attracts administrative penalties up to VT 1,000,000, escalation fines, and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion — VAT and municipal levy fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of turnover on VAT returns to reduce output tax; baseless zero-rating claims on invoices issued to non-resident clients; failure to register for VAT once the VT 5,000,000 threshold is crossed while conducting local taxable activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Value Added Tax Act (No. 4 of 2009): penalty of 100% of the tax evaded plus default interest; criminal fines up to VT 10,000,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years; municipal business licence forfeiture.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for the tax loss; conviction triggers disqualification from VFSC-regulated functions, travel bans may be imposed during investigation, and restitution orders attach to personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company and false economic substance declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying economic substance in the IC annual return while no office, employees, records, or expenditure exist; carrying on a designated relevant activity without substance solely to access the zero-tax regime; using the IC as a brass-plate shell for pass-through invoicing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: International Companies (Economic Substance) (Amendment) Act 2019: administrative penalty up to VT 1,000,000; repeated default draws fines up to VT 10,000,000 and administrative strike-off; a false statement under the IC Act is a criminal offence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable if the default results from their direction; courts may order disgorgement of fiscal benefits as civil restitution; offending directors are placed on the VFSC disqualified list and barred from acting in any VFSC-regulated entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Utilizing the EOR payroll platform to move funds for sanctioned persons, structuring payroll disbursements to evade registered-agent monitoring, or failing to perform client due diligence on non-resident employers and contractors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML/CFT Act (No. 7 of 2017): regulatory fines up to VT 5,000,000 per breach against the IC and beneficial owners; freezing orders; suspension or revocation of VFSC registration and licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face criminal liability for knowingly permitting money laundering — imprisonment up to 5 years, fines up to VT 5,000,000, travel bans, and international mutual-assistance proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intermingling client payroll trust funds with IC operating accounts, preferring certain creditors or directors while insolvent, or distributing dividends without solvency headroom.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: International Companies Act (Cap. 222) and applicable insolvency principles: restitutionary awards, statutory fines up to VT 500,000, director disqualification orders, and disclosure of VFSC records to foreign tax authorities under information-exchange mechanisms.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil, rendering directors personally liable to restore withheld contractor salaries; personal insolvency with asset freezes, and criminal proceedings for fraudulent trading.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Information exchange and international cooperation non-compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure by the registered agent to maintain accurate beneficial-ownership registers; refusal to comply with VFSC requests under the Exchange of Information Act; obstruction of Global Forum requests for financial records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Exchange of Information (International Assistance) Act (Cap. 284): monetary penalties for non-compliance, injunctive enforcement, and strike-off upon VFSC order; adverse findings may be shared with treaty partners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers obstructing an information request face fines up to VT 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 12 months; directors' foreign assets become traceable under international confiscation proceedings.
